name: v0.31.3
body:
## Highlights
* Lots of bugfixes
* Thread local generation stream to accompany MLX v0.31.2

## What's Changed
* Bump the patch version by @angeloskath in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-lm/pull/1124
* Fix batch dimension mismatch in BatchKVCache and BatchRotatingKVCache extend() by @razorback16 in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-lm/pull/1141
* Fix parallel tool call handling in server by @kernelpool in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-lm/pull/1170
* Fix MiniMax M2 parallel tool calling by @kernelpool in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-lm/pull/1171
* Fix missing tree_reduce import in models/cache.py by @siiea-ai in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-lm/pull/1165
* Apertus tie_word_embeddings fix by @BlackSamorez in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-lm/pull/1143
* Fix batch dimension mismatch in ArraysCache extend() by @techtoboggan in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-lm/pull/1169
* Fix dwq: check for actual safetensors in target_dir by @micuentadecasa in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-lm/pull/1173
* fix: handle NoneType check for think tokens in TokenizerWrapper by @yuetyeelo2855 in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-lm/pull/1167
* Fix Gemma4 tool parser: support hyphenated function names and braces in string args by @AkashKhamkar in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-lm/pull/1150
* Fix empty tool_call_end breaking Mistral tool calls by @eyupcanakman in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-lm/pull/1151
* Fix ArraysCache extend by @angeloskath in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-lm/pull/1177
* Fix Gemma 4 KV-shared layers creating unused projections by @glyphVault in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-lm/pull/1158
* Thread local generation stream by @angeloskath in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-lm/pull/1090

## New Contributors
* @razorback16 made their first contribution in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-lm/pull/1141
* @siiea-ai made their first contribution in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-lm/pull/1165
* @BlackSamorez made their first contribution in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-lm/pull/1143
* @techtoboggan made their first contribution in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-lm/pull/1169
* @micuentadecasa made their first contribution in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-lm/pull/1173
* @yuetyeelo2855 made their first contribution in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-lm/pull/1167
* @AkashKhamkar made their first contribution in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-lm/pull/1150
* @glyphVault made their first contribution in https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-lm/pull/1158

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-lm/compare/v0.31.2...v0.31.3
